# openmetadata_domain (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata domain. Domains group data assets by business area and can be nested under a parent domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_domain" "engineering" {
  name         = "Engineering"
  display_name = "Engineering"
  description  = "Engineering-owned data assets."
  domain_type  = "Source-aligned"
}

resource "openmetadata_domain" "platform" {
  name        = "Platform"
  domain_type = "Aggregate"
  parent      = openmetadata_domain.engineering.fully_qualified_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_type` (String) Domain type: Source-aligned, Consumer-aligned or Aggregate.
- `name` (String) Domain name. Changing it replaces the domain, because the name is part of its fully qualified name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the domain.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.
- `parent` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent domain for nested domains. Changing it replaces the domain.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name, for example Engineering or Engineering.Platform.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_domain.engineering 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, which for a top-level domain is its name.
terraform import openmetadata_domain.engineering Engineering

# Nested domains use the parent.child form.
terraform import openmetadata_domain.platform Engineering.Platform
```
